name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | Blue Razz Jolli Popz
description:
Bright and tangy with a candy twist, Blue Razz Jollipopz delivers bold blue raspberry flavor that pops. Smooth, flavorful, and built on our Max Pro platform, this 3G disposable is made for fans of sweet-meets-tart profiles.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
